## Time series cross

<a id="opIdGetTimeSeriesCross"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.twelvedata.com/time_series/cross?base=JPY&quote=BTC&interval=1min' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /time_series/cross`

The Time Series Cross endpoint calculates and returns historical cross-rate data for exotic forex pairs, cryptocurrencies, or stocks (e.g., Apple Inc. price in Indian Rupees) on the fly. It provides metadata about the requested symbol and a time series array with Open, High, Low, and Close prices, sorted descending by time, enabling analysis of price history and market trends.

<h3 id="time-series-cross-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|base|query|string|true|Base currency symbol|
|base_type|query|string|false|Base instrument type according to the `/instrument_type` endpoint|
|base_exchange|query|string|false|Base exchange|
|base_mic_code|query|string|false|Base MIC code|
|quote|query|string|true|Quote currency symbol|
|quote_type|query|string|false|Quote instrument type according to the `/instrument_type` endpoint|
|quote_exchange|query|string|false|Quote exchange|
|quote_mic_code|query|string|false|Quote MIC code|
|interval|query|[IntervalEnum](#schemaintervalenum)|true|Interval between two consecutive points in time series|
|outputsize|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of data points to retrieve. Supports values in the range from `1` to `5000`. Default `30` when no date parameters are set, otherwise set to maximum|
|format|query|[FormatEnum](#schemaformatenum)|false|Format of the response data|
|delimiter|query|string|false|Delimiter used in CSV file|
|prepost|query|boolean|false|Only for the `Pro` plan (individual) and `Venture` plan (business) and above.<br>Available at the `1min`, `5min`, `15min`, and `30min` intervals for US equities.<br>Open, high, low, close values are supplied without volume.|
|start_date|query|string|false|Start date for the time series data|
|end_date|query|string|false|End date for the time series data|
|adjust|query|boolean|false|Specifies if there should be an adjustment|
|dp|query|integer(int64)|false|Specifies the number of decimal places for floating values.<br>Should be in range [0, 11] inclusive.|
|timezone|query|string|false|Timezone at which output datetime will be displayed. Supports:<br><ul><br><li>1. <code>Exchange</code> for local exchange time</li><br><li>2. <code>UTC</code> for datetime at universal UTC standard</li><br><li>3. Timezone name according to the IANA Time Zone Database. E.g. <code>America/New_York</code>, <code>Asia/Singapore</code>. Full list of timezones can be found <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones" target="blank">here</a>.</li><br></ul><br><i>Take note that the IANA Timezone name is case-sensitive</i>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|interval|1min|
|interval|5min|
|interval|15min|
|interval|30min|
|interval|45min|
|interval|1h|
|interval|2h|
|interval|4h|
|interval|8h|
|interval|1day|
|interval|1week|
|interval|1month|
|format|JSON|
|format|CSV|

## ETFs directory

<a id="opIdGetETFsList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twelvedata.com/etfs/list \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /etfs/list`

The ETFs directory endpoint provides a daily updated list of exchange-traded funds, sorted by total assets in descending order. This endpoint is useful for retrieving comprehensive ETF data, including fund names and asset values, to assist users in quickly identifying the ETFs available.

<h3 id="etfs-directory-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|symbol|query|string|false|Filter by symbol|
|figi|query|string|false|Filter by financial instrument global identifier (FIGI). This parameter is available on the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/pricing">Ultra</a> plan (individual) and the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/pricing-business">Enterprise</a> plan (business) and above.|
|isin|query|string|false|Filter by international securities identification number (ISIN). ISIN access is activating in the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/account/add-ons">Data add-ons</a> section|
|cusip|query|string|false|The CUSIP of an instrument for which data is requested. CUSIP access is activating in the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/account/add-ons">Data add-ons</a> section|
|cik|query|string|false|The CIK of an instrument for which data is requested|
|country|query|string|false|Filter by country name or alpha code, e.g., `United States` or `US`|
|fund_family|query|string|false|Filter by investment company that manages the fund|
|fund_type|query|string|false|Filter by the type of fund|
|format|query|[FormatEnum](#schemaformatenum)|false|The format of the response data|
|delimiter|query|string|false|The separator used in the CSV response data|
|dp|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of decimal places for floating values|
|page|query|integer(int64)|false|Page number|
|outputsize|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of records in response|

## MFs families

<a id="opIdGetMutualFundsFamily"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twelvedata.com/mutual_funds/family \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /mutual_funds/family`

The mutual funds family endpoint provides a comprehensive list of MF families, which are groups of mutual funds managed by the same investment company. This data is useful for users looking to explore or compare different fund families, understand the range of investment options offered by each, and identify potential investment opportunities within specific fund families.

<h3 id="mfs-families-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fund_family|query|string|false|Filter by investment company that manages the fund|
|country|query|string|false|Filter by country name or alpha code, e.g., `United States` or `US`|

## MFs directory

<a id="opIdGetMutualFundsList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twelvedata.com/mutual_funds/list \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /mutual_funds/list`

The mutual funds directory endpoint provides a daily updated list of mutual funds, sorted in descending order by their total assets value. This endpoint is useful for retrieving an organized overview of available mutual funds.

<h3 id="mfs-directory-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|symbol|query|string|false|Filter by symbol|
|figi|query|string|false|Filter by financial instrument global identifier (FIGI). This parameter is available on the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/pricing">Ultra</a> plan (individual) and the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/pricing-business">Enterprise</a> plan (business) and above.|
|isin|query|string|false|Filter by international securities identification number (ISIN). ISIN access is activating in the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/account/add-ons">Data add-ons</a> section|
|cusip|query|string|false|The CUSIP of an instrument for which data is requested. CUSIP access is activating in the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/account/add-ons">Data add-ons</a> section|
|cik|query|string|false|The CIK of an instrument for which data is requested|
|country|query|string|false|Filter by country name or alpha code, e.g., `United States` or `US`|
|fund_family|query|string|false|Filter by investment company that manages the fund|
|fund_type|query|string|false|Filter by the type of fund|
|performance_rating|query|integer(int64)|false|Filter by performance rating from `0` to `5`|
|risk_rating|query|integer(int64)|false|Filter by risk rating from `0` to `5`|
|format|query|[FormatEnum](#schemaformatenum)|false|The format of the response data|
|delimiter|query|string|false|The separator used in the CSV response data|
|dp|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of decimal places for floating values|
|page|query|integer(int64)|false|Page number|
|outputsize|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of records in response|

|---|---|
|format|JSON|
|format|CSV|

## MF full data

<a id="opIdGetMutualFundsWorld"></a>

```bash
curl https://api.twelvedata.com/mutual_funds/world \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /mutual_funds/world`

The mutual full data endpoint provides detailed information about global mutual funds. It returns a comprehensive dataset that includes a summary of the fund, its performance metrics, risk assessment, ratings, asset composition, purchase details, and sustainability factors. This endpoint is essential for users seeking in-depth insights into mutual funds on a global scale, allowing them to evaluate various aspects such as investment performance, risk levels, and environmental impact.

<h3 id="mf-full-data-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|symbol|query|string|false|Symbol ticker of mutual fund|
|figi|query|string|false|Filter by financial instrument global identifier (FIGI). This parameter is available on the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/pricing">Ultra</a> plan (individual) and the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/pricing-business">Enterprise</a> plan (business) and above.|
|isin|query|string|false|Filter by international securities identification number (ISIN). ISIN access is activating in the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/account/add-ons">Data add-ons</a> section|
|cusip|query|string|false|The CUSIP of an instrument for which data is requested. CUSIP access is activating in the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/account/add-ons">Data add-ons</a> section|
|country|query|string|false|Filter by country name or alpha code, e.g., `United States` or `US`|
|dp|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of decimal places for floating values. Accepts value in range [0,11]|

## Sustainability

<a id="opIdGetMutualFundsWorldSustainability"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.twelvedata.com/mutual_funds/world/sustainability \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /mutual_funds/world/sustainability`

The mutual funds sustainability endpoint provides detailed information on the sustainability and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) ratings of global mutual funds. It returns data such as ESG scores, sustainability metrics, and fund identifiers.

<h3 id="sustainability-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|symbol|query|string|false|Symbol ticker of mutual fund|
|figi|query|string|false|Filter by financial instrument global identifier (FIGI). This parameter is available on the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/pricing">Ultra</a> plan (individual) and the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/pricing-business">Enterprise</a> plan (business) and above.|
|isin|query|string|false|Filter by international securities identification number (ISIN). ISIN access is activating in the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/account/add-ons">Data add-ons</a> section|
|cusip|query|string|false|The CUSIP of an instrument for which data is requested. CUSIP access is activating in the <a href="https://twelvedata.com/account/add-ons">Data add-ons</a> section|
|country|query|string|false|Filter by country name or alpha code, e.g., `United States` or `US`|
|dp|query|integer(int64)|false|Number of decimal places for floating values. Accepts value in range [0,11]|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "mutual_fund": {
    "sustainability": {
      "score": 22,
      "corporate_esg_pillars": {
        "environmental": 3.73,
        "social": 10.44,
        "governance": 7.86
      },
      "sustainable_investment": false,
      "corporate_aum": 0.99486
    }
```

|end_cash_position|number(double)|false|none|Returns the amount of cash a company has when adding the change in cash and beginning cash balance for the current fiscal period|
|income_tax_paid|number(double)|false|none|Refers to supplemental data about income tax paid|
|interest_paid|number(double)|false|none|Refers to supplemental data about interest paid|
|free_cash_flow|number(double)|false|none|Represents the cash a company generates after accounting for cash outflows to support operations and maintain its capital assets|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fiscal_date|string|true|none|Date of fiscal period ending|
|quarter|integer(int64)|false|none|Fiscal quarter. Visible when `&period=quarterly`|
|year|integer(int64)|false|none|Fiscal year|
|sales|integer(int64)|false|none|Refers to total reported revenue|
|cost_of_goods|integer(int64)|false|none|Refers to cost of revenue|

|non_operating_interest|[IncomeStatementBlock_non_operating_interest](#schemaincomestatementblock_non_operating_interest)|false|none|Non-operating interest details|
|other_income_expense|integer(int64)|false|none|Refers to other incomes or expenses|
|pretax_income|integer(int64)|false|none|Refers to earnings before tax: `operating_income` + `net_non_operating_interest` - `other_income_expense`|
|income_tax|integer(int64)|false|none|Refers to a tax provision|
|net_income|integer(int64)|false|none|Refers to net income: `pretax_income` - `income_tax`|
|eps_basic|number(double)|false|none|Refers to earnings per share (EPS)|
|eps_diluted|number(double)|false|none|Refers to diluted earnings per share (EPS)|
|basic_shares_outstanding|integer(int64)|false|none|Refers for the shares outstanding held by all its shareholders|
|diluted_shares_outstanding|integer(int64)|false|none|Refers to the total number of shares a company would have if all dilutive securities were exercised and converted into shares|
|ebit|integer(int64)|false|none|Refers to earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) measure|
|ebitda|integer(int64)|false|none|Refers to EBITDA (earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization) measure|
|net_income_continuous_operations|integer(int64)|false|none|Refers to the after-tax earnings that a business has generated from its operational activities|
|minority_interests|integer(int64)|false|none|Refers to amount of minority interests paid out|
|preferred_stock_dividends|integer(int64)|false|none|Refers to dividend that is allocated to and paid on a company's preferred shares|

Current assets section

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|cash|number(double)|false|none|Cash includes currency, bank accounts, and undeposited checks|
|cash_equivalents|number(double)|false|none|Represents cash equivalents that have high credit quality and are highly liquid|
|cash_and_cash_equivalents|number(double)|false|none|Combined value of cash and cash equivalents when company doesn't report a breakdown|
|other_short_term_investments|number(double)|false|none|Represents other short term investments|
|accounts_receivable|number(double)|false|none|Represents the balance of money due to a firm for goods or services delivered or used but not yet paid for by customers|
|other_receivables|number(double)|false|none|Represents other receivables|
|inventory|number(double)|false|none|Represents the goods available for sale and raw materials used to produce goods available for sale|
|prepaid_assets|number(double)|false|none|Represents expense that has already been paid for, but which has not yet been consumed|
|restricted_cash|number(double)|false|none|Represents money that is held for a specific purpose and thus not available to the company for immediate or general business use|
|assets_held_for_sale|number(double)|false|none|Represents assets which company plans to sell|
|hedging_assets|number(double)|false|none|Represents money that is spent on hedging assets|
|other_current_assets|number(double)|false|none|Represents other current assets|
|total_current_assets|number(double)|false|none|All current assets values in a total|

Non-current assets section

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|properties|number(double)|false|none|Represents property owned|
|land_and_improvements|number(double)|false|none|Represents land and improvements owned|
|machinery_furniture_equipment|number(double)|false|none|Represents office equipment, furniture, and vehicles owned|
|construction_in_progress|number(double)|false|none|Represents the cost of construction work, which is not yet completed|
|leases|number(double)|false|none|Represents operating and financial leases|
|accumulated_depreciation|number(double)|false|none|Represents the cumulative depreciation of an asset that has been recorded|
|goodwill|number(double)|false|none|Represents the value of a brand name, solid customer base, good customer relations, good employee relations, and proprietary technology|
|investment_properties|number(double)|false|none|Represents real estate property purchased with the intention of earning a return on the investment|
|financial_assets|number(double)|false|none|Represents liquid asset that gets its value from a contractual right or ownership claim|
|intangible_assets|number(double)|false|none|Represents the patents, trademarks, and other intellectual properties|
|investments_and_advances|number(double)|false|none|Represents available for sale financial securities|
|other_non_current_assets|number(double)|false|none|Represents other long-term assets|
|total_non_current_assets|number(double)|false|none|All long-term assets values in total|

Current liabilities section

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accounts_payable|number(double)|false|none|Refers to an account within the general ledger that represents an obligation to pay off a short-term debt to creditors or suppliers|

|short_term_debt|number(double)|false|none|Represents current debt and capital lease obligations|
|deferred_revenue|number(double)|false|none|Represents advance payments a company receives for products or services that are to be delivered or performed in the future|
|tax_payable|number(double)|false|none|Represents taxes due to the government within one year|
|pensions|number(double)|false|none|Represents to pensions to be paid out|
|other_current_liabilities|number(double)|false|none|Represents other current liabilities|
|total_current_liabilities|number(double)|false|none|Represents total current liabilities|

Shareholders' equity section of the balance sheet

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|common_stock|number(double)|false|none|Represents net worth of investors shares, which is equal to the total_assets - total_liabilities|
|retained_earnings|number(double)|false|none|Refers to the profits earned minus dividends paid|
|other_shareholders_equity|number(double)|false|none|Represents other not affecting retained earnings gains and looses|
|total_shareholders_equity|number(double)|false|none|Represents the net worth of a company, which is the amount that would be returned to shareholders if a company's total assets were liquidated, and all of its debts were repaid|
|additional_paid_in_capital|number(double)|false|none|Represents the additional paid-in capital, which is the amount shareholders have invested in a company above the par value of its stock|
|treasury_stock|number(double)|false|none|Represents the value of shares that have been repurchased by the company and are held in its treasury|
|minority_interest|number(double)|false|none|Represents the portion of shareholders' equity that is attributable to minority shareholders in a subsidiary company|

```json
  "close": "148.85001",
  "volume": "624277"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|datetime|string|true|none|Datetime in local market time for equities and in UTC for forex and cryptocurrencies referring to when the bar with specified interval was opened|
|cci|string|true|none|CCI value|
|open|string|false|none|Price at the opening of current bar. Returned when `include_ohlc` is `true`.|
|high|string|false|none|Highest price which occurred during the current bar. Returned when `include_ohlc` is `true`.|
|low|string|false|none|Lowest price which occurred during the current bar. Returned when `include_ohlc` is `true`.|
|close|string|false|none|Close price at the end of the bar. Returned when `include_ohlc` is `true`.|
|volume|string|false|none|Trading volume which occurred during the current bar. Returned when `include_ohlc` is `true`.|

Valuation metrics of the company

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|market_capitalization|number(double)|false|none|Refers to the market value of the company's outstanding shares|
|enterprise_value|number(double)|false|none|Refers to enterprise value (EV) of the company, often used as a more comprehensive alternative to market capitalization|
|trailing_pe|number(double)|false|none|Refers to the trailing price-to-earnings (P/E). It is calculated by taking the current stock price and dividing it by the trailing earnings per share (EPS) for the past 12 months|
|forward_pe|number(double)|false|none|Refers to the forward price-to-earnings ratio. It is calculated by dividing the current share price by the estimated future earnings per share|
|peg_ratio|number(double)|false|none|The price/earnings to growth (PEG) ratio is a price-to-earnings ratio divided by the growth rate of the earnings|
|price_to_sales_ttm|number(double)|false|none|The price-to-sales (P/S) ratio is a valuation ratio that compares the market capitalization to its revenues over the last 12 months|
|price_to_book_mrq|number(double)|false|none|The price-to-book (P/B) ratio is equal to the current share price divided by the book value of all shares (BVPS) over the last quarter|
|enterprise_to_revenue|number(double)|false|none|The enterprise value-to-revenue multiple (EV/R) is a measure that compares enterprise value to revenue|
|enterprise_to_ebitda|number(double)|false|none|The enterprise value-to-ebitda multiple (EV/EBITDA) is a measure that compares enterprise value to EBITDA|

Operating activities section

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|net_income|number(double)|false|none|Returns net income (NI). Calculated as sales minus cost of goods sold|
|depreciation|number(double)|false|none|Represents depreciation and amortization measure|
|deferred_taxes|number(double)|false|none|Stands for taxes that are owed but are not due to be paid until a future date|
|stock_based_compensation|number(double)|false|none|Refers to share-based compensation as the way of paying employees, executives, and directors of a company with equity in the business|
|other_non_cash_items|number(double)|false|none|Represents other non-cash items|
|accounts_receivable|number(double)|false|none|Represents the balance of money due to a firm for goods or services delivered or used but not yet paid for by customers|
|accounts_payable|number(double)|false|none|Refers to an account within the general ledger that represents an obligation to pay off a short-term debt to creditors or suppliers|
|other_assets_liabilities|number(double)|false|none|Represents cumulative changes in inventory, other current assets, other current liabilities, and other working capital|
|operating_cash_flow|number(double)|false|none|Returns operating cash flow (OCF) measure representing a total amount of cash generated by company's normal business operations|
